name: nginx
description: The official NGINX Open Source repository.
one_liner: The software that most of the internet's websites use to serve pages fast, balance traffic, and stay online under load.
buyer: Honestly, nobody buys 'nginx' itself — it's free, foundational infrastructure. The closest buyer is a small business owner who pays someone else to configure it for them.
business_use_cases: A freelance sysadmin offers a flat-fee 'nginx speed and security audit' to small e-commerce sites before a big sales event.
A managed-hosting shop bundles nginx configuration and tuning into their support retainer for small business clients.
A consultant builds a one-click 'secure nginx config generator' product for solo founders who don't know server administration.

money_ideas.idea: One-off nginx performance/security configuration audit for a small business's site
Subscription managed-hosting support retainer that includes ongoing nginx tuning

steal_this: Offer one local e-commerce site a flat-fee 'is your site ready for Black Friday traffic' nginx audit this weekend.
